column1: # Global skill of the equilibrium woody-carbon map, kg C m-2.
# Model: drivers from job 6978605, 400-yr offline equilibrium, 22420 land columns,
# precipitation-limited woody allocation (map_half = 0.8 m/yr) as shipped.
# bias   = mean(model) - mean(obs)          on cells where the product has data
# cRMSE  = RMSE with the bias removed       (pattern error alone)
# obs_sd = spatial standard deviation of the observations

# were carbon and reported a median of 4.38; corrected it is 2.88, i.e. the
# products agree BETTER than was claimed and the model has more room to improve.
